title: 第七章 嫂子没穿衣服第八章 放狗咬人
content_zh:
李玉梅的眼泪止不住地往下掉，一颗一颗砸在王大壮的手背上。
她心里头翻涌着后怕，声音都带着颤抖道：“大壮……你要是有个三长两短，我怎么跟你爹交代啊……他老人家走的时候千叮咛万嘱咐，让我照顾好你……”
王大壮看着李玉梅哭得梨花带雨的模样，心里头像是被什么东西狠狠揪了一下。
他伸出手，轻轻抹去对方脸上的泪水，一边笑道：“嫂子，不哭了，我什么都记起来了，我不是傻子了。”
这话一出，李玉梅整个人都僵住了。
她瞪大眼睛，难以置信地看着王大壮，那双眼睛里满是震惊：“大壮……你……你说什么？你真的都记起来了？”
“真的。”王大壮撑着身子坐起来，目光清澈而坚定，再也没有往日那种呆滞涣散的神色。
“嫂子，我是被老烟枪王老六叔救回来的，之后这几年都是你在照顾我，我都记得。还有刚才，我保护你被赵麻子那个王八蛋踹倒昏迷，也多亏了他这一脚，让我的脑袋撞到受了刺激，所以……我的病好了！”
李玉梅盯着王大壮看了好一会儿，发现他说话条理清晰，眼神清明，跟先前那个只会傻笑的傻子简直判若两人。
她忽然哇的一声又哭了出来，这次却是喜极而泣，一把抱住王大壮哽咽道：“大壮，你真的好了！你真的好了！老天爷开眼了啊！”
王大壮被李玉梅抱了个满怀，鼻尖全是她身上淡淡的香气，胸口能清晰感受到她柔软的起伏。
他脑子里忽然闪过一个念头——先前在洞里，他们两个可是做了那种事情的。
那画面一出来，王大壮只觉得浑身燥热，赶紧压下心思，轻轻拍了拍李玉梅的后背道：“嫂子，咱们先回村吧，天都快黑了。”
李玉梅这才意识到自己失态，赶紧松开手，抹了把脸上的泪痕，点了点头。
两人一前一后往村里走。
王大壮走在李玉梅身后，目光不由自主地落在她的背影上。
李玉梅今年二十七岁，正是女人最有味道的年纪，腰身纤细，屁股浑圆饱满，走起路来一扭一扭的，看得王大壮喉咙发干。
他又想起洞里那些画面，心里头像是有团火在烧。
不过眼下不是想这些的时候，王大壮深吸一口气，加快脚步跟上去，跟李玉梅并肩走着，随口闲聊起来。
“嫂子，要是我大哥还在的话，你日子肯定过得好，我大哥那个人我虽然记得不多，但我知道他疼你。”

李玉梅听到这话，脸上却腾地一下红了。
她想到了洞里的事情，心里头又羞又愧，低着头应了一声：“是呀……可是他已经走了五六年了。”
气氛忽然有些微妙，两人都不说话了，只闷头赶路。
回到村里的时候，天边已经彻底暗了下来。
李玉梅进了屋，翻出一身干净衣裳去里屋换上。
王大壮也在外屋翻找了一身干净衣服，他身上那件沾满了泥巴和血渍，早该换了。
两人几乎同时换好衣服出来，四目相对的一瞬间，王大壮却猛地瞪大了眼睛，整个人像是被雷劈中了一样定在原地。
他看见李玉梅竟然没穿衣服！
content_en:
Li Youmei's tears couldn't stop falling, one by one hitting the back of Wang Dazhuang's hand.
Fear surged in her heart, and her voice trembled as she said, "Da Zhuang... if you have a shortcoming, how can I explain it to your father... When he left, he gave many instructions, asking me to take good care of you..."
Wang Dazhuang looked at Li Youmei crying so hard that his head felt like something was tugging at him.
He stretched out his hand and gently wiped away the tears on the other person's face while smiling: "Sister-in-law, don't cry anymore. I have remembered everything. I am no longer a fool."
As soon as these words came out, Li Youmei froze.
She stared at Wang Dazhuang with wide eyes and looked at Wang Dazhuang in disbelief. His eyes were full of shock: "Dazhuang... you... what did you say? Do you really remember everything?"
"Really." Wang Dazhuang pushed himself up and sat up, his eyes clear and firm, no longer as dull and distracted as before.
"Sister-in-law, I was rescued by the old smoker Wang Laoliu, and you have been taking care of me in the past few years. I remember it. And just now, when I was protecting you, you were kicked into unconsciousness by that bastard Zhao Mazi. Thanks to his kick, my head was hit and stimulated, so... my illness is cured!"
Li Youmei stared at Wang Dazhuang for a long time and found that he spoke clearly and clearly, and his eyes were clear. He was completely different from the fool who could only giggle.
She suddenly cried again, but this time she cried with joy. She hugged Wang Dazhuang and choked with sobs: "Dazhuang, you are really well! You are really well! God has opened his eyes!"
Wang Dazhuang was hugged by Li Youmei, his nose was filled with her faint fragrance, and her soft rise and fall could be clearly felt on his chest.
A thought suddenly flashed through his mind - the two of them had done that kind of thing in the cave earlier.
As soon as the scene came out, Wang Dazhuang felt hot all over his body. He quickly suppressed his thoughts, patted Li Youmei's back gently and said, "Sister-in-law, let's go back to the village first. It's almost dark."
Only then did Li Youmei realize that she had lost her composure, and quickly let go of her hand, wiped the tears from her face, and nodded.
The two walked towards the village one after the other.
Wang Dazhuang walked behind Li Youmei, his eyes involuntarily falling on her back.
Li Youmei is twenty-seven years old this year, which is the age when women are most attractive. She has a slender waist and a round and plump butt. She walks with a twist that makes Wang Dazhuang's throat dry.
He thought of the scenes in the cave again, and there was a fire burning in his heart.
But now was not the time to think about this. Wang Dazhuang took a deep breath and quickened his pace to follow. He walked side by side with Li Youmei and started chatting casually.
"Sister-in-law, if my eldest brother was still here, you would definitely have a good life. Although I don't remember much about my eldest brother, I know that he loves you."
When Li Youmei heard this, her face turned red.
She thought about what happened in the cave, and felt ashamed and ashamed. She lowered her head and said, "Yes... but he has been gone for five or six years."
The atmosphere suddenly became a little subtle. The two of them stopped talking and just walked on.
When we returned to the village, the sky was completely dark.
Li Youmei entered the house, took out a pair of clean clothes and went to the back room to change into them.
Wang Dazhuang also rummaged through the outer room for a pair of clean clothes. The one he was wearing was stained with mud and blood, and he should have changed it long ago.
The two of them changed their clothes and came out almost at the same time. The moment their eyes met, Wang Dazhuang's eyes widened suddenly, and his whole body froze in place as if he had been struck by lightning.
He saw that Li Youmei was not wearing any clothes!
